clips.title: The story
paras: The Temple Gardens form the tranquil, water-filled heart of Darnassus, surrounding small islets just north of the Temple of the Moon. Decorated with bridges and pristine flora, the district hosts the city bank and the mystical tree portal leading to the base of Teldrassil.

Spanning the waters at the center of Darnassus, the Temple Gardens serve as the crossroads of the night elven capital. Wooden bridges connect its landscaped islets to the Cenarion Enclave in the north, the bustling terraces to the east, and the grand sanctuary of the Temple of the Moon to the south. The night elves carefully shape the district's flowing waters and lush foliage, creating a serene atmosphere that offers rest to travelers and priestesses alike.
